t: This is Holy Trinity Church in Marylebone, a Grade One listed building, now a former Anglican church. It was built in 1828 and designed by Sir John Soane. Soane specialised in the Neo-Classical style. He was the son of a bricklayer who rose to the top of his profession, becoming professor of architecture at the Royal Academy and an official architect to the Office of Works. He was knighted in 1831. This church is one of his works.
